newPatient.consentText: Ka bayyana wa mara lafiyar a harshensa dalilin da ya sa kake ajiye bayanansa, kuma zai iya ƙi.

newPatient.statement: Muna so mu ajiye bayanan lafiyarka a wannan wayar mu kuma tura su lafiya zuwa Ghana Health Service, domin ma'aikatan lafiyarka su ci gaba da kula da kai. Ma'aikatan lafiyarka kaɗai ne za su gani. Za ka iya cewa a'a, kuma za ka iya cewa mu daina a kowane lokaci. Ka yarda?

call.title: Video consultation

call.waitingHint: Keep this screen open. The call starts as soon as they join.
call.full: Two people are already in this call.

call.error_camera: Allow the camera and microphone for HealthConnect, then try again.
call.error_offline: Video calls need the internet. Connect to mobile data or Wi-Fi and try again.
call.error_closed: This teleconsultation is closed, so it has no call.
call.error_no_path: The phones could not reach each other. This network needs a relay (TURN) server; try mobile data or Wi-Fi instead.

call.tapForSound: Tap to turn on the sound
call.error_payment: The consultation fee isn't paid yet. The CHV can collect it from Visits.
call.error_window: This call isn't open now. It opens 15 minutes before the booked time and closes 2 hours after.

payments.title: Payments
payments.pending: Payment of {{amount}} started — not confirmed yet
payments.how: The patient approves on their own phone (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash or AirtelTigo Money). The call opens once it's paid.
payments.waitForChv: The CHV collects the fee with the patient. The call opens once it's paid.
payments.exempt: No fee: emergencies never wait for payment.
payments.error_sync: This visit hasn't reached the server yet. Sync, then try again.
payments.error_off: Payments aren't switched on here yet.
payments.error_provider: The payment service isn't answering. Try again in a minute.
payments.error_other: The payment couldn't start. Try again.
payments.checkingHint: If the patient hasn't approved it on their phone yet, ask them to do it now.
payments.stillPending: The payment isn't confirmed yet. Check again from Visits in a few minutes.
payments.notPaid: The payment didn't go through. You can try again from Visits.
payments.cantCheck: The payment couldn't be checked. Check again from Visits when you have a signal.
payments.offline: Payments need a connection. Try again when you have a signal.
payments.demo: Payments aren't part of the offline demo. Sign in to the live service to see them.
payments.notSynced: This visit hasn't reached the server yet. Once it syncs, the fee and the call appear here.
payments.cantCheckNow: The fee couldn't be checked just now. Pull down to refresh, or try again in a minute.

forecast.title: Mako mai zuwa: hasashen zazzaɓi
forecast.intro: Marasa lafiya masu zazzaɓi da ake tsammani a mako mai zuwa, daga makonni 8 da suka wuce na kowace gunduma. Yi amfani da shi don shirya gwajin malaria da magunguna.
forecast.stock_one: Shirya: malaria RDT {{count}} da paracetamol don majiyyaci {{count}}.
forecast.stock_other: Shirya: malaria RDT {{count}} da paracetamol don marasa lafiya {{count}}.
forecast.method: Hanyar lissafi mai sauƙi (Holt's method) a kan ƙididdigar kowane mako: jagora ne don tsari, ba tabbaci ba. Ba a amfani da makonnin da marasa lafiya ba su kai 5 ba.

education.title: Ilimin lafiya
education.intro: Gajerun darussan lafiya don karantawa, ko kunnawa da ƙarfi ga majiyyaci ko iyali.
education.homeHint: Malaria, hawan jini, ciki, ORS da sauransu
education.goNow: Je cibiyar lafiya yanzu idan akwai
education.noVoice: Wannan wayar ba za ta iya karantawa da ƙarfi ba. Karanta rubutun ga majiyyaci.
education.englishOnly: A yanzu darussan suna cikin Turanci. Za a ƙara rikodin Twi, Ewe, Hausa da Dagbani bayan masu magana da harsunan sun duba su.
